mapper.sql: select p.program_id, p.school_id, s.school_name, s.school_name_en, s.country, p.program_name, p.program_name_en, p.degree, p.field_group, p.major_direction, p.duration_months, p.intakes, p.tuition, p.currency, p.teaching_language, p.website, p.aps_required, p.difficulty, p.verified_by, p.verified_time, p.status, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark from abr_program p join abr_school s on s.school_id = p.school_id

mapper.insert: insert into abr_program (school_id, program_name, program_name_en, degree, field_group, major_direction, duration_months, intakes, tuition, currency, teaching_language, website, aps_required, difficulty, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{schoolId}, coalesce(#{programName}, ''), #{programNameEn}, #{degree}, #{fieldGroup}, coalesce(#{majorDirection}, ''), #{durationMonths}, coalesce(#{intakes}, ''), #{tuition}, coalesce(#{currency}, ''), coalesce(#{teachingLanguage}, 'en'), coalesce(#{website}, ''), coalesce(#{apsRequired}, 'N'), coalesce(#{difficulty}, ''), coalesce(#{status}, '0'), #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update abr_program set school_id = #{schoolId}, program_name = coalesce(#{programName}, ''), program_name_en = #{programNameEn}, degree = #{degree}, field_group = #{fieldGroup}, major_direction = coalesce(#{majorDirection}, ''), duration_months = #{durationMonths}, intakes = coalesce(#{intakes}, ''), tuition = #{tuition}, currency = coalesce(#{currency}, ''), teaching_language = coalesce(#{teachingLanguage}, 'en'), website = coalesce(#{website}, ''), aps_required = coalesce(#{apsRequired}, 'N'), difficulty = coalesce(#{difficulty}, ''), status = coalesce(#{status}, '0'), remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where program_id = #{programId} and del_flag = '0'
